metadata.title: SGU Episode 418
metadata.quote: If you strip the horrors of history from history, the flip side of that is you strip the nobility of rising above such horrors.

sections.text: You're listening to the Skeptics' Guide to the Universe, your escape to reality.
sections.title: Introduction

sections.text: Evan and Steve share their recent visit to the Grand Canyon and some recent science.
sections.title: Special Report
Interview with James Randi and Jamy Ian Swiss

metadata.title: Interview with James Randi and Jamy Ian Swiss

sections.text:
Item #1: Scientists have successfully transplanted insulin-producing islet cells from one species to another which survived without the use of immunosuppressive drugs.
Item #2: For the first time astronomers have identified the color of an exoplanet - a blue world that may get its color from raining glass.
Item #3: Researchers report they have successfully treated a genetic disorder in two patients by deliberately infecting them with HIV.
sections.title: Science or Fiction

sections.text: What is it that stops you from slipping into cynicism? How come you don't wake up every day and say, "Ah, screw it - let the gullible people fend for themselves and I'll be OK."
sections.title: Question #1: Cynicism

sections.text: If you strip the horrors of history from history, the flip side of that is you strip the nobility of rising above such horrors.
